name: Leeds immediate-work searcher without a car

context.occupation: Retail and customer-service worker; open to adjacent local work
context.geography: Near Leeds; reachable on foot or public transport from home
constraints: Strict affordable commute at actual shift times
Uses phone for search and applications
Flexible job title, less flexible workplace location
context.company_awareness: No target-company strategy; knows local shops but searches by distance and availability

trigger: Finds an immediate-start opening, then discovers the earliest bus arrives after the required start time.

searches_run.query: retail customer service jobs Leeds immediate start
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned national job-board categories, local listings and a Tate temporary customer-service result. Attempting to inspect the Tate page returned HTTP 410 Gone; its snippet could not establish a current opening.

searches_run.query: jobs Leeds no car bus accessible early late shifts
searches_run.observation: Results included local commute discussions, care roles requiring driving and a theatre job description. Direct inspection of the theatre document found unsociable hours and evening shifts, but no exact finishing times to validate a bus journey.

sources.title: Customer Service Advisor — Tate
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet advertised an immediate-start three-month Leeds role; direct open returned 410 Gone, so the vacancy was not confirmed available.

sources.title: Retail Immediate Start Jobs Leeds — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved category page targets local urgent retail intent; no live vacancy availability or ranking claim is derived.

sources.title: Customer Experience Assistant job description — Leeds Heritage Theatres
sources.supports: Direct employer PDF describes permanent annualised part-time hours, unsociable work and Thursday–Saturday matinee/evening shifts; exact finishes and commute feasibility remain unspecified.

sources.title: Healthcare Support Worker Leeds, Driver with Manual Licence — Work Hub
sources.supports: Retrieved public jobs result explicitly requires driving and lists early/late shifts; a broad local query can surface roles unsuitable for this person's transport constraint.

best_entry_page.primary_query: jobs near me Leeds immediate start no car
best_entry_page.promise: No dedicated acquisition promise until the product demonstrates local frontline coverage, exact workplace locations and a workable way to check shift-time commutes.
best_entry_page.cta: Use employer vacancy details and a transport planner to check a specific shift before applying
proof_needed: Mobile search and application handoff tested
Exact workplace addresses rather than company headquarters
Shift start/end details or explicit unknowns
Evidence that company selection does not block a role-flexible search

conversion_objections: I do not care which company it is if I can get there and start soon.
Does Leeds mean the centre or an industrial estate?
I cannot pay for another search tool.
Will this work entirely on my phone?
Can I get home after a closing shift?
A saved-company list adds work before I can see useful openings.

avoid_targeting.query: jobs near me accessible by bus guaranteed
avoid_targeting.reason: No public-transport routing or commute guarantee is demonstrated.
Start dates and hiring speed are employer-controlled.

avoid_targeting.query: jobs no CV instant apply Leeds
avoid_targeting.reason: No automatic or universal instant application flow is shown.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need a job I can reach by bus, not a list of companies to follow. If I have to make an account and choose employers before I can check the place and shift times, I will go back to a local jobs page.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic poor-fit test, not a customer interview. Two searches, one failed direct opening and one successfully inspected employer PDF. Other searches are hypotheses. No exact home address was assigned, so no commute is inferred. No traffic, conversion, freshness or regional coverage claims. Company-first discovery and missing transport verification are material mismatches, not issues that alerts alone solve.

search_journey.fit_reason: Company-first selection adds friction and speed is not guaranteed.
Role/location works if frontline coverage exists.
